name.ja: <ruby>煉<rt>れん</rt></ruby><ruby>獄<rt>ごく</rt></ruby>の<ruby>零門<rt>ゼロ・ゲート</rt></ruby>

text.en: Skip your next Draw Phase. When an opponent's monster with ATK greater than or equal to your LP declares a direct attack and you have no cards in your hand: You can banish this card from your GY; negate the attack, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Void Ogre Dragon" monster from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Synchro Summon). While it is face-up in the Monster Zone, you take no damage. When it leaves the field, take 4000 damage.
